Morning team,

Attached is the Partner Center export I pulled this morning for the Contoso intake (contoso_pc_account_census_v1.csv). We have 48 accounts listed as 'referral candidates' from the intake form. Before I push a formal Partner Center referral, I want to confirm seller ownership and mark any accounts that need field-consent or manual claim.

Two asks:
- Can Karthik run this against the field roster (seller alias list) and flag which accounts have an active Azure seller (preferred: seller has >1 touch in last 90 days)?
- Vanessa: please identify accounts that need explicit seller consent (we should capture emails) and highlight ones Contoso specifically asked to keep regional ownership for.

I propose we keep a single source-of-truth CSV (attached) and then create a short MA Plan doc for Contoso/Microsoft to sign-off. My plan is to loop Steve Miller at Microsoft once we have the cleaned census so they can enable the referral and confirm co-sell eligibility.

I'll start a 30-minute sync tomorrow if that helps — otherwise we can triage asynchronously.

Thanks,
Jordan

Thanks for starting this, Jordan. I did a quick pass against the active seller roster and flagged 12 accounts where seller ownership is ambiguous (attached notes column in the CSV). Short summary:

- 5 accounts appear to be shared across two sellers (AP & NA overlaps)
- 4 have no recent Azure activity in the last 12 months (likely orphaned)
- 3 are owned by an EU seller but Contoso requested US routing for this project

For the ambiguous accounts I recommend:
1) Try consent-first outreach (email template below) to the listed sellers — if no response in 72 hrs, set as "field-orphan" and include in PC referral but mark as "needs follow-up" in MA Plan.
2) For EU-owned accounts Contoso explicitly asked to keep US-handling — need explicit written approval from the EU seller.

If you want, I can start the outreach today. Also adding Karthik to run the match rules for last-touch and opportunity ties.

Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Partner Programs Manager
Redwood Inference

Jordan / team,

Thanks for the note and for the draft MA Plan. Partner Center prefers CSV for bulk intake; include the following columns: account_tenant, account_display_name, seller_upn, seller_consent (yes/no), seller_consent_timestamp (ISO), region_preference. If you include HubSpot ID we will map to the opportunity.

A couple quick items:
- We can enable the referral once we see seller_consent=yes for the majority (>75%) of accounts. For any orphaned accounts we will place them in a "PC-managed" bucket and Microsoft field will try to assign a seller within 10 business days.
- DocuSign for MA Plan is fine — share the link and we will countersign.
- Please avoid sending personal emails of sellers in bulk; use the consent template and BCC field when possible.

I'll start the intake once you upload the cleaned CSV to our secure intake site. I'll also loop in the local seller (Emma) to provide any manual ownership guidance for the EU->US edge cases.

Best,
Steve Miller
Partner Center Operations
Microsoft Corp
